contract: Seek to the preceding Cue for a single 48 kHz mono AC-3 track with empty CodecPrivate, zero CodecDelay and zero SeekPreRoll.
Each operation opens a seekable view of the full preloaded input, seeks backward, reads every packet to EOF and releases the reader.
Use the public libavformat source view with NOPARSE and NOFILLIN and floor the target to the stream time base before seeking.
Fold the landing, the track, timestamp and duration presence and values, length and bytes of every packet, and successful EOF.
